intellectual_tradition: Summit of Qianlong-Jiaqing evidential scholarship (Anhui school, puxue); materialist naturalism; pioneer of Chinese enlightenment ethics; from Xiuning, Anhui
historical_significance: 戴震（1724—1777），字东原，安徽休宁隆阜人，清代乾嘉考据学皖派宗师、杰出唯物主义哲学家。出身寒微，早年随父贩布，自学成才，师事江永。精通天文、数学、地理、音韵、训诂，四库全书馆特召为纂修官。他以「由词通道」的方法论重建儒学：训诂明而后义理明，把考据学从支离文字提升为哲学重建的路径。代表作《孟子字义疏证》批判宋儒「存理灭欲」为「以理杀人」，提出「理存于欲」「体民之情，遂民之欲」的启蒙伦理观，被章太炎、梁启超、胡适推为清代思想解放的先声、中国近代启蒙思想的先驱。
core_thoughts: 理存于欲（理不离欲，欲之失为私，非理禁欲）
以理杀人批判（后儒以理责下，酷于酷吏之法）
由词通道（训诂明而后义理明，考据与义理统一）
分理说（理者，察之几微必区以别——分析性理性）
血气心知（人性论：血气资养以益，心知扩而充之）
解蔽去私（认知二患：蔽与私）
气化即道（道犹行也，气化流行，生生不息）
famous_quote: 人死于法，犹有怜之者；死于理，其谁怜之！
influence: 戴震是乾嘉学术最高峰与清代哲学最深刻者。他以训诂考据的实证方法重释《孟子》，从字义疏证中解构程朱「理欲对立」的形上学，把「理」还原为「条分缕析之情」，把伦理学还原为对民生疾苦的体察，开出中国本土的启蒙主义路径。其「以理杀人」之论影响了龚自珍、谭嗣同、章太炎至五四一代对礼教批判的思想脉络；其考据方法奠定皖派规范，段玉裁、王念孙王引之父子皆出其门墙或受其沾溉。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·理》：理也者，情之不爽失也。……有欲而后有为，有为而归于至当不易之谓理。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Principle is precisely the condition in which feeling does not err. … Where there is desire there is action, and action attaining what is fitting and unchanging is called principle.
mode_evidence.source: 理也者，情之不爽失也。……有欲而后有为，有为而归于至当不易之谓理。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《孟子字义疏证》/《与某书》：人死于法，犹有怜之者；死于理，其谁怜之！
mode_evidence.evidence_en: One who dies by law still has those who pity him; one who dies by 'principle'—who would pity him!
mode_evidence.source: 人死于法，犹有怜之者；死于理，其谁怜之！

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《与是仲明论学书》/《尔雅注疏笺补序》：由字以通其词，由词以通其道。……训诂明而后义理明。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: From characters, reach the words; from words, reach the Way. … Only when philological exegesis is clear can moral principle be clear.
mode_evidence.source: 由字以通其词，由词以通其道。……训诂明而后义理明。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·理》：理者，察之而几微必区以别之名也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Principle is the name for that which, on close examination of its subtlest details, must be discriminated into distinct particulars.
mode_evidence.source: 理者，察之而几微必区以别之名也。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·性》/《原善》：血气资饮食以养，心知于前世之开明，资于学问以进于神明。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Blood and qi are nourished by food and drink; the mind's knowing, nourished by learning, advances toward luminous clarity.
mode_evidence.source: 血气资饮食以养，心知于前世之开明，资于学问以进于神明。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·理》：人之患在私与蔽：去私莫如强恕，解蔽莫如学。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The human ailments are self-interest and obscuration: nothing removes self-interest better than empathy; nothing removes obscuration better than learning.
mode_evidence.source: 人之患在私与蔽：去私莫如强恕，解蔽莫如学。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·天道》/《绪言》：道犹行也；气化流行，生生不息，是故谓之道。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The Way is like movement: the flowing transformation of qi, generating life without cease—this is called the Way.
mode_evidence.source: 道犹行也；气化流行，生生不息，是故谓之道。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·理》：以我之情絜人之情，而无不得其平。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Weigh others' feelings with one's own as the measure, and equilibrium is found in every case.
mode_evidence.source: 以我之情絜人之情，而无不得其平。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《与姚孝廉姬传书》/《方言疏证》《考工记图》：凡学未至贯本末、彻精粗，徒以意衡量，终身不得闻道。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: If learning has not reached through root and branch, fine and coarse, but relies on mere opinion, one will never in a lifetime hear the Way.
mode_evidence.source: 凡学未至贯本末、彻精粗，徒以意衡量，终身不得闻道。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·才》/《答郑丈用牧书》：仆自十七岁以来，有志闻道，谓非求之六经孔孟不得，非从事于字义制度名物，无由以通其语言。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Since seventeen I have aspired to hear the Way; it cannot be sought except in the Six Classics and Confucius and Mencius, and their language cannot be mastered except through the study of word meanings, institutions, and names of things.
mode_evidence.source: 仆自十七岁以来，有志闻道，谓非求之六经孔孟不得，非从事于字义制度名物，无由以通其语言。

cross_references.description_zh: 朱熹以「理」为超验本体、主张「存天理灭人欲」；戴震把「理」还原为情欲之条理、斥后儒之理为「以理杀人」。二人同释一「理」字，方向截然相反：朱是形上学的道德形制，戴是经验论的启蒙伦理。
cross_references.description_en: Zhu Xi made 'principle' a transcendent ontology and urged preserving heavenly principle while extinguishing human desire; Dai Zhen reduced principle to the ordered pattern of feeling and desire, denouncing the later Confucian 'principle' as 'killing by principle.' The same character, opposite directions: Zhu's metaphysical moral order versus Dai's empiricist enlightenment ethics.

cross_references.description_zh: 顾炎武开清代考据学之先河（'经学即理学'），戴震承其路数而登峰造极：把考据从方法论提升为哲学重建（由词通道），并使皖派考据规范（段玉裁、王念孙王引之）成为乾嘉学术的正统。
cross_references.description_en: Gu Yanwu pioneered Qing evidential scholarship ('classical learning is precisely the study of principle'); Dai Zhen inherited his path and brought it to its summit, elevating philology from method to philosophical reconstruction (from words to the Way), and making the Anhui-school standards the orthodoxy of Qianlong-Jiaqing learning.

cross_references.description_zh: 王夫之与戴震都重建理欲关系（'人欲之各得即天理之大同'与'理存于欲'），但路径不同：王以气学形上学历程抵达，戴以训诂考据的经验方法抵达——一为体系哲学，一为语言学论证的启蒙伦理。
cross_references.description_en: Both Wang Fuzhi and Dai Zhen rebuilt the principle-desire relation ('the due satisfaction of each desire is the great commonality of heavenly principle' vs. 'principle resides in desire'), but by different routes: Wang through qi-learning metaphysics, Dai through the empirical method of philology—one systematic philosophy, one enlightenment ethics argued linguistically.

modern_value_zh: 理存于欲——制度的人性基准：谈道德先问是否体民之情、遂民之欲，反对以抽象名义压制基本人性
以理杀人批判——话语权力审计：谁在定义'理'，谁被'理'定义；单向施加的道德即是压迫
由词通道——概念纪律：用词先考其本义与演变，警惕大词空洞化替代思考
分理分析——分析性理性：拒绝笼统结论，逐层分辨、逐点求证
证据递进考据——事实核查纪律：本证、旁证、反证分栏，孤证存疑、反证优先
解蔽去私——认知与利益双自查：判断被扭曲，先查是学力不足还是利益驱动
modern_value_en: Principle resides in desire: the human baseline of institutions—ask whether they empathize with people's feelings and fulfill their needs before moralizing
Critique of killing by principle: audit discursive power—who defines the principle, who is defined by it; one-way moralism is oppression
From words to the Way: conceptual discipline—examine a term's root meaning before using it; beware hollow big words replacing thought
Analytic discrimination: analytical rationality—refuse sweeping conclusions; discriminate layer by layer and verify point by point
Cumulative-evidence verification: fact-checking discipline—separate direct, indirect, and adverse evidence; suspect solitary evidence, prioritize counterevidence
Uncovering obscuration and self-interest: double self-audit of cognition and interest—when judgment goes wrong, first ask whether it is ignorance or incentive
place_of_origin: Longfu, Xiuning County, Huizhou, Anhui (now Longfu, Huangshan, Anhui)
unique_thing: Dai Zhen's core achievement was 'grounding morality back in living desire and rebuilding philosophy through philology.' From a poor merchant's family and largely self-taught, he rose to be the greatest scholar of his age by insisting that 'only when philological exegesis is clear can moral principle be clear'—then used that method to deconstruct the Neo-Confucian opposition of heavenly principle to human desire. His verdict—'one who dies by law still has those who pity him; one who dies by principle, who would pity him?'—made him, in the eyes of Zhang Taiyan, Liang Qichao and Hu Shi, the herald of China's own enlightenment: conscience audited structurally, desire restored to dignity, and every big word held to the test of evidence.
